title: betula verrucosa var. platyphylla
intro: Betula verrucosa var. platyphylla, commonly known as White Birch, is a variant of the birch tree species that is native to Europe and Asia. This plant is known for its health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of White Birch include its use in treating skin conditions, such as eczema and acne, as well as its ability to soothe and calm irritated tissues. The bioactive constituents of Betula verrucosa var. platyphylla include salicin, a compound that is also found in willow bark and is known for its anti-inflammatory and analgesic properties.
